interface.title: Sentinel Browser (vresto) v0.4.7
interface.field: Earth observation / remote sensing (Copernicus Sentinel satellite imagery)
interface.stage_of_work: Finding data and looking at it first: search the catalogue, check coverage, preview scenes and pull point time series before downloading or analysing
interface.what_it_is_for: Search and filter Copernicus satellite scenes by place, date, cloud cover and product level, view Sentinel-2 coverage per MGRS tile on a map, preview scenes with context layers on top, chart a point's NDVI history and export it as CSV.

data.note: No data is bundled. Everything comes live from public services: the Copernicus catalogue (OData) and the Element84 Earth Search STAC index on AWS Open Data. Searches and scene listings worked without an account. Reading pixel values failed in this environment: TCI streaming always failed, and every pixel-history reading came back with status 'error'. The Esri satellite basemap also stayed grey. Quicklook, metadata and band download need Copernicus credentials, which were not set.

features.name: Coverage-shaded tile grid with hover counts
features.general: Show a map grid of fixed tiles, each shaded by how many observations fall in the chosen time window. Hover a tile to read its count and best quality, then click it to act on that tile.
features.specific: MGRS grid coloured by Sentinel-2 L2A products per tile per month (Earth Search index). The tooltip reads e.g. '31UFT · 16 products (16/month) · best 8% cloud — click to stream'. Switches turn the grid and the colouring on and off. The colouring is meant to follow the calendar range, but neither run confirmed a re-colour after a range change.
steps: set a date range
zoom in to zoom level 8 so tiles appear (the grid did not draw at 7, although the help text says 5 or more)
read the colour legend (0, <3, 3–5, 6–8, 9–11, 12+)
hover a tile for its count and best cloud cover
click the tile to open its scene picker
serves_tasks: See how many scenes cover each tile in the period
Pick one scene of a tile to load

features.specific: 'Select a product for tile 31UFT' dialog: latest matches in the selected date range (cloud cover ≤50%), each with its full product name, acquisition time, cloud %, a thumbnail area and a 'Stream this tile' button.
steps: click a tile
read the candidate list (date, cloud %)
press Stream this tile on one candidate, or Cancel
serves_tasks: Pick one scene of a tile to load

features.name: Point time-series panel with CSV export
features.general: Click a point on a map to chart a variable over time. Valid and flagged readings are drawn differently. Pick the variable and the time window, scrub through dates with a slider, and export the series as CSV.
features.specific: 'Pixel history' panel over the map. Turn on 'Pick a point', then click. Variable choices: NDVI · Sentinel-2 (no account needed), FAPAR, Dry Matter Productivity, Soil Moisture or Soil Water Index (the last four need CDSE S3 keys). Period choices: Selected dates, Last 6 months, Last 12 months or Last 3 years. The chart legend separates Clear from Cloud/shadow/snow, and the panel shows 'N scenes · M clear'. A date slider works with 'Show date on map'. The CSV link downloads vresto_ndvi_<lat>_<lon>.csv with per-scene status, ndvi, red, nir, scl, scene cloud cover and item_id. A map popup also gives the coordinates and scene counts.
steps: turn on Pick a point
click a location on the map
read the chart and the scene/clear counts
change Period or Variable (the series reloads)
drag the date slider to step through scenes
press CSV to download the series
serves_tasks: Chart a variable over time at a clicked point
Change the time window of the series
Step through the dates of the series
Export the time series for analysis elsewhere

features.name: Area-of-interest drawing plus filtered catalogue search
features.general: Draw a point or shape on a map, set filters for collection, processing level, maximum cloud cover and result count, and get back a list of matching items with key metadata and actions.
features.specific: Leaflet draw toolbar (polyline, polygon, rectangle, circle, marker, circlemarker, edit, delete) combined with the Search Filters panel (Collection SENTINEL-2/1/3/5P/LANDSAT-8; Product Level L1C/L2A; Max Cloud Cover; Max Results). Search returns cards like 'Found 15 products (filtered from 15 total)' with name, date, size and cloud %, plus Quicklook and Metadata buttons. Searching without a drawn location gives a warning.
steps: choose a draw tool and mark a point or rectangle
set Collection and Product Level
type Max Cloud Cover and Max Results
press Search
browse the result cards (Quicklook and Metadata need credentials)
serves_tasks: Mark the place of interest on the map
Search for scenes at the marked place, filtered by collection, processing level and cloud cover

features.name: Date-range calendar that drives the other views
features.general: A calendar where two clicks set a start and end date. The range then feeds the coverage map, the scene searches and the time-series window.
features.specific: 'Select date (or range)' calendar with month and year arrows. The header shows the range and day count (e.g. 'Oct 2026 · 15 days'), and a line below reads '2026-10-17 to 2026-10-31'. The 'Selected dates' period in Pixel history follows it; the MGRS colouring is meant to follow it too (not confirmed). On a fresh page the first click may clear the default range instead of setting the start day.
steps: move to the month you want with the arrows
click the start day
click the end day
check the range line under the calendar
serves_tasks: See how many scenes cover each tile in the period
Change the time window of the series

features.name: Filterable one-at-a-time context overlay list
features.general: A grouped catalogue of reference layers (land cover, terrain, vegetation, thermal, water, hazards) with a text filter. Expand one entry to switch it on and set its opacity. Only one is active at a time, and it follows the selected map cell.
features.specific: Overlays section of the Tile Streaming panel: WorldCover 2021, LCM 2020, Global LC 100m, Tree Cover Density, DEM terrain, NDVI climatology, FAPAR, Dry Matter Prod., LST hourly, Soil Moisture, Soil Water Index, Water Bodies, Burned Area. Each has a 'Show overlay' switch and an opacity slider. Typing in the filter (e.g. 'soil') narrows the list. An overlay can be marked active ('Active: WorldCover 2021 · 20261028'), but it only displays after a tile has streamed.
steps: type in Filter overlays…
expand an overlay entry
turn on Show overlay (needs a streamed tile)
adjust the opacity slider
serves_tasks: Find a context layer (land cover, terrain, soil, water) to lay over the scene
